notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
